content.short: Rysk is an options protocol letting holders earn upfront yield on crypto assets.
content.description: Rysk turns option premiums into upfront yield for asset holders, so depositors receive payment now in exchange for the obligation an option creates, rather than waiting for a strategy to accrue. It operates on Hyperliquid. Structuring the return as an immediate payment rather than a projected APY is an honest framing, since it makes the trade being made explicit.
